faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.cta: Didn’t find your question? Send the product, size, quantity and destination country — we will reply with a detailed offer.
faq.groups[0].title: Company
faq.groups[0].items[0].q: Are you a gas cylinder manufacturer?
faq.groups[0].items[0].a: Yes. Wanda Group specializes in manufacturing gas cylinders and related industrial gas supply solutions for overseas industrial buyers.
faq.groups[0].items[1].q: What products do you mainly supply?
faq.groups[0].items[1].a: We supply acetylene cylinders, propane cylinders, acetylene generators and gas cylinder accessories such as valves, regulators, hoses, pressure gauges and torches.
faq.groups[0].items[2].a: Yes. Cylinder color, marking, valve, cap and packing options can be discussed according to the order and the target market.
faq.groups[0].items[3].a: Yes. We support export, product selection, packing requirements, documentation and shipping coordination.
faq.groups[0].items[4].q: How can I get a quote?
faq.groups[0].items[4].a: Please specify the product type, cylinder size, quantity, destination country and customization requirements through the inquiry form or by email. Our team will reply with product details and a quotation.
faq.groups[1].items[0].q: Can I watch factory videos before placing an order?
faq.groups[1].items[1].q: Do you provide product videos, especially for acetylene cylinders?
faq.groups[1].items[2].q: Can you show videos of production and quality control?
faq.groups[1].items[3].q: Can I request a product video made for a specific order?
faq.groups[2].title: Solutions
faq.groups[2].items[0].q: What gas cylinder solutions do you offer?
faq.groups[2].items[0].a: We offer solutions for welding and cutting, gas distribution, industrial storage, acetylene generation, OEM supply and export purchasing.
faq.groups[2].items[1].q: Can you recommend products for my application?
faq.groups[2].items[1].a: Yes. Send your application, cylinder size, quantity, destination country and required accessories — we will recommend suitable products.
faq.groups[2].items[2].q: Do you supply accessories together with cylinders?
faq.groups[2].items[2].a: Yes. We can supply pressure regulators, hoses, gauges, cutting torches, welding torches, valves and fittings together with the cylinders.
faq.groups[2].items[3].q: Can you supply gas cylinders for OEM buyers?
faq.groups[2].items[3].a: Yes. Cylinder color, marking, valve, cap, logo and packing can be discussed according to the order.
faq.groups[3].title: Products
faq.groups[3].items[0].q: What is a dissolved acetylene cylinder used for?
faq.groups[3].items[0].a: Dissolved acetylene cylinders are widely used for welding, cutting, brazing, metal fabrication and industrial gas supply.
faq.groups[3].items[1].q: What cylinder sizes can you supply?
faq.groups[3].items[1].a: Various volumes and capacities can be discussed depending on your target market, application and order quantity. To confirm, specify the required size or local standard.
faq.groups[3].items[2].q: Can cylinder color, valve and marking be changed?
faq.groups[3].items[2].a: Yes. Cylinder color, valve, cap, marking, label and export packing can be made to order.
faq.groups[4].title: Accessories
faq.groups[4].items[0].a: We supply flashback arrestors, pressure gauges, safety valves, oxygen hoses, hose clamps, cutting torches, welding torches, filters, adapters and other gas cylinder accessories.
faq.groups[4].items[1].q: Can gas cylinder accessories be customized?
faq.groups[4].items[1].a: Yes. We can customize logo, packing, connection size, thread type, pressure range and technical specifications.
faq.groups[4].items[2].q: Can accessories be ordered together with gas cylinders?
faq.groups[4].items[2].a: Yes. Accessories can be supplied together with acetylene cylinders, propane cylinders and acetylene generators.
faq.groups[4].items[3].a: Yes. For wholesale orders we can provide OEM marking, cartons, bags and product labels.
faq.groups[4].items[4].q: Can you provide product photos and specifications?
faq.groups[4].items[5].q: How can I get a quote for accessories?
faq.groups[4].items[5].a: Please specify the product name, quantity, connection size, working pressure, packing requirements and destination country or port.
